title: SRE on-call scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Shift: 08:00-16:00 PST (primary)
Handed off to: Noah Chen at 16:00 (he's covering evening)

Summary:
- Early-morning noisy paging (02:15-02:40 UTC) for v1/generate p99 latency spikes. Root cause appears to be coordinated cache-eviction across a subset of dedicated GPU nodes after a rolling OS patch. Autoscaler reacted and we had transient 5-10s token latency spikes for ~25% of requests.
- Follow-ups and action items below; raised INC-4821 for tracking and postmortem.

Pages handled (quick notes):
- 02:18 UTC: Pager from /v1/generate p99 increase - acknowledged, escalated to infra-oncall (Noah) - stack traces point to KV cache miss storms.
- 02:26 UTC: Alert firing for fifo-queue length on gpu-pool-7 - scaled up extra pods, healthchecks recovered.
- 03:10 UTC: Rate-limit blips for a single customer route (acct: acme-inc). Slack thread: <slack thread link above>. Customer retry logic surfaced as contributing factor.

Incidents:
- INC-4821 (primary): "KV cache eviction + autoscaler interaction causes p99 spike"
  - Timeline: 02:10 first errors -> 02:18 paging -> 02:40 steady after scale-up -> 03:05 monitoring green
  - Impact: elevated p99 for ~30min, ~12% of requests saw >2s extra latency, no errors returned (timeouts) but client-side retries observed.
  - Mitigations taken: rolled back the new OS config on 3 nodes (gpu-pool-7), increased autoscaler min for that pool temporarily, disabled aggressive cache revalidation in serving-runtime (flag: --kv-cache-revalidate=false)
  - Next: postmortem + follow-up TODOs (see below)

- INC-4834 (secondary): "Customer route high retry rate" - WIP, assigned to Priya for customer comms and rate-limit tuning.

Notes / Quick debugging pointers:
- Logs: full traces uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2026-03-04/INC-4821/ (TODO: add link to confluence after upload finishes)
- Query to reproduce p99 spike locally: run load test script scripts/load-test/generate-spike.sh with --seed=2026-03-04 --concurrency=120 against staging-gpu-7.
- Useful spans: serving-runtime::kv_fetch, autoscaler::scale_event, nginx::request_time (see trace ids in Slack thread).

Runbook TODOs (short-term edits):
- [ ] Add explicit step in "KV cache eviction" runbook to temporarily raise autoscaler min before manual cache flush. (file: confluence runbook page)
- [ ] Document the --kv-cache-revalidate flag and when to flip it (owner: me)
- [ ] Add a checklist for rolling OS patches on GPU pools: stagger windows, verify cache warmup, monitor p99 for 15m after each node. (owner: infra team / release-engineering)

Action items and owners:
- Sophia: create INC-4821 postmortem skeleton + timeline (due 2026-03-06).
- Noah: run the reproducer in staging and capture profiler (assigned) - results in PR with artifact.
- Priya: customer comms for acme-inc and adjust soft-rate-limits if needed. (follow-up: JIRA-INC-4834)
- Infra (cc: Raj): review OS patch process for gpu pools and add pre- and post-checks into release playbook.

Follow-ups for next on-call:
- Check that autoscaler min for gpu-pool-7 is returned to normal after 48h of stability.
- Verify no other pools had similar eviction windows (grep kernel logs across nodes).
- Confirm runbook edits published and link added to INC-4821.

Misc notes / scratch items: 
- Possible long-term: look into softer eviction policy + warming pass for KV caches during rollouts (talk to research/serving-runtime).
- Consider adding a synthetic that simulates cache-thrashing pattern to detect regression earlier.
- Follow: PR #3241 changes to cache revalidation - need to review whether it introduced edge-case when combined with new kernel config.

Personal TODOs (today):
- [x] Triage early pages, coordinate mitigation
- [ ] Draft postmortem outline (INC-4821)
- [ ] Edit KV cache eviction runbook (add autoscaler step)
- [ ] Sync with infra about patch windows (15m)
- [ ] Add reproducer results to PR notes

Hand-off notes for evening on-call (Noah):
- Keep autoscaler min bumped for gpu-pool-7 until stable for 48h.
- If p99 spikes again: run reproducer in staging, capture perf profile, escalate to eng-serving-runtime. If observed error rates >0.5% open page to SRE-sre and paging to eng-serving-runtime.
- Contact list: Raj (infra lead), Priya (CS/customer), Lila (serving-runtime).

Random small reminders:
- submit expense for conference (do it at lunch)
- check calendar for retro on 2026-03-07

End of scratchpad.
